verdict.rationale: Resend has no built-in natural-language interface, but it ships an official MCP server (github.com/resend/resend-mcp) for Cursor, Claude and other MCP clients. The docs say that server can add and verify domains and manage webhooks, so users can operate the product in natural language through an external agent. Broadcast scheduling also accepts natural-language times such as "in 1 min". missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of full MCP tool coverage across all operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
